groups.meta: a few minutes a run with the skip
conditions: Skip Phase 1: ignore his drone's three ambushes and run into the next tile, which must be his next spawn point, not a dead end. In a squad only one player needs to reach it.
Systems droughts of 25+ runs happen at 22.56%; that is bad luck, not a bug.
bonuses: The Terra Frame phase is fully vulnerable; just dump damage.

disclosures.title: the drone phases
disclosures.body: His head and backpack weak spots only open during the 10-second Propaganda Broadcast, and he goes invulnerable again after losing 35% health. Splash weapons (Tonkor, Sonicor, Ignis, Kuva Ogris with Nightwatch Napalm) hit the weak spots consistently. Molecular Prime, Rhino Stomp, Avalanche or Zenurik's Temporal Drag slow him enough to aim. The minimap briefly shows the correct exit right before he spawns.

disclosures.title: other sources
disclosures.body: The Vay Hek Frequency Triangulator pays the same parts at the same rates on Rotation C. After The Duviri Paradox, Hydroid is week 6 of the Normal Circuit with Mirage and Limbo: Neuroptics tier 2, Chassis 5, Systems 8, main 10. Mixing sources works, e.g. Vay Hek for two parts and the Circuit for Systems.
